Name: Nintendo Furniture
Author: MrFox420
Description: A mod I had made over a year ago, and remade to replace the vanilla furniture with video game themed stuff. Just place it in your SV Content folder under tiles to replace the vanilla one. For the floors and walls just replace the walls_and_floors xnb file in the main Content folder. Or use XNB Loader.

Downloads.Description:
The new updated Nintendo Furniture mod I made. This replaces a lot of the old boring furniture of SV.
This is for any fellow Nintendo fans. You need to have Content Patcher installed to use this version.
